essence: After eating all foods offered by devotees, one should practice while muttering with the remainder.
In the accomplishment of the great mantra, restraint according to one's own will is prescribed.
Instead of performing purification, one should maintain a mind free from conceptualization.
One should request Kaula nectar, but if it is unavailable, one should drink water.
If one takes the offering without bowing, one would go to hell.
